name: cell
wording: one unit the corpus is made of, such as a factor's value, a role, a persona or a skill, authored once in signs: the single source from which what each harness receives is projected, so a harness's copy is regenerated from its cell and never edited, and every harness carries the same meaning in its own form. The corpus is the cells cratylus ships.
reason: The agents context's relation says the corpus expresses factors and values as cells, and decisions 0044 and 0049 speak of role cells and of cells fanned out per factor, but no concept defined a cell. Defined as the unit of meaning and the one source of projection, so meaning never lives in a harness's copy; what an agent is and how it is composed stays the agents context's, and projection and install stay delivery's.
